WITH trips AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP AS ts, from_json(POLYLINE, 'array<array<double>>') AS poly
  FROM raw_trips
  WHERE coalesce(MISSING_DATA, '') <> 'True' AND TIMESTAMP IS NOT NULL
), usable AS (
  SELECT ts, poly,
         unix_timestamp(from_utc_timestamp(timestamp_seconds(ts), 'Europe/Lisbon')) - ts AS utc_offset_s
  FROM trips
  WHERE size(poly) >= 2
), segments AS (
  SELECT ts + utc_offset_s AS local0, i,
         poly[i - 1][0] AS lon1, poly[i - 1][1] AS lat1, poly[i][0] AS lon2, poly[i][1] AS lat2
  FROM usable LATERAL VIEW explode(sequence(1, size(poly) - 1)) s AS i
), classified AS (
  SELECT *,
         (lon1 BETWEEN -8.8 AND -8.45 AND lat1 BETWEEN 41.05 AND 41.3) AND (lon2 BETWEEN -8.8 AND -8.45 AND lat2 BETWEEN 41.05 AND 41.3) AS both_inside,
         2 * 6371.0 * asin(sqrt(pow(sin((radians(lat2) - radians(lat1)) / 2), 2) + cos(radians(lat1)) * cos(radians(lat2)) * pow(sin(radians(lon2 - lon1) / 2), 2))) AS km
  FROM segments
)
SELECT CAST(floor(((lat1 + lat2) / 2 - 41.05) / 0.005) AS INT) AS row,
       CAST(floor(((lon1 + lon2) / 2 - -8.8) / 0.005) AS INT) AS col,
       CAST(pmod(floor((local0 + (i - 1) * 15) / 3600), 24) AS INT) AS hour,
       count(*) AS n_segments,
       sum(km) AS total_km,
       count(*) * 15 AS total_s
FROM classified
WHERE both_inside AND km <= 0.625
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
